text:
Priya R.: Customer cust-118 called out INV-6732 with a surprising overage: looks like 18k burst tokens were charged twice across APAC pools and they also experienced timeouts during the same window. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_6732.pdf :eyes:
Ethan M.: Can you paste the line items? which billing window?
Priya R.: Window 2026-07-08 -> 2026-08-07. Condensed extract: ```line_item_id,desc,nodepool,region,committed,used,burst,amount
G4001,Reserved commit - apac-east,apac-east,apac,150000,140000,0,7500.00
G4002,Burst - apac-east,apac-east,apac,150000,18000,18000,900.00
G4003,Burst - apac-west,apac-west,apac,0,18000,18000,900.00
G4004,Reserved commit - apac-west,apac-west,apac,50000,48000,0,2500.00
``` Duplicated 18k burst -> ~$900 duplicated charge. Also customer reported 5xx spikes for ~22 minutes in that window.
billing-bot: Metering event mp-9902: tag flip due to live-failover for cust-118 at 2026-07-21T15:11:08Z. Mirror/route duration 00:22:30. Logs: /meters/mp-9902.log
Laila S.: Runtime notes: we see a short failover and the metering proxy re-assigned tags without preserving origin_tag. That can create two billable streams. I also see an exchange-rate conversion routine applied differently for apac-west line, causing a small rounding discrepancy (about $12).
Priya R.: Customer is also asking for SLA credit because of the 5xx. We need to separate (A) duplicated burst billing, (B) currency/rounding issue, and (C) SLA credit for availability.
Ethan M.: Policy summary: (1) Duplicate billing caused by our tag re-assignment -> full duplicated burst credit + 5% goodwill on next invoice. (2) Rounding/currency variance due to vendor feed error -> adjust and reissue invoice. (3) SLA: if customer saw > 5m sustained errors in a 30m window and our SLO was missed, issue SLA credit per contract (up to one month pro rata). Require evidence for each.
Priya R.: I've uploaded token-hash export and 5xx traces to case BILL-2026-486. Token export: /exports/cust-118/20260721_token_hash.csv. 5xx traces: /traces/cust-118/20260721_5xx.zip. Invoice placed on hold until 2026-07-30.
infra-bot: Incident INC-APAC-20260721 recorded for the runtime spike. Detector flagged increased latency 15:09 -> 15:33 UTC. Remediation: restart of apac-east pool.
Laila S.: Remediation note: we're deploying ingress origin_tag persistence to avoid re-tagging during failovers. INFRA-919 created, ETA 10d. Also filing vendor ticket VEND-317 to correct exchange-rate feed mapping for apac-west.
Marcus (Revenue): Finance-side: provisional approvals: (a) duplicated burst credit up to $1,100, (b) rounding adj up to $25, (c) SLA provisional credit up to $1,500 if SLO violation confirmed. Use JE codes: DUP-BURST-7, XR-ADJ-3, SLA-REV-1 and memos referencing BILL-2026-486. Finance will hold funds pending token dedupe and SLA verification.
Ethan M.: Required evidence checklist: 1) token dedupe showing identical token ids across nodepools in same UTC windows, 2) mapping of both line_items G4002/G4003 to cust-118, 3) 5xx traces showing sustained error rate crossing SLO, 4) vendor acknowledgement for exchange-rate error.
Priya R.: Devops started the dedupe job. ETA 5h. Output path: /exports/cust-118/dedupe_20260721_report.json. Billing team to request vendor reclassification for G4003 as non-billable mirror and to reissue INV-6732 net of XR adj.
Marcus (Revenue): Once dedupe confirms duplication, Finance will post provisional JE entries and notify accounting to expect an adjusted invoice. Approvals noted here are provisional and will be finalized after vendor reclassification.
Laila S.: Also flagging product: can we add a non-billable mirror flag upstream so mirrored requests never hit billing? Adding INFRA-921 for non-billable marker.
Priya R.: I'll update the customer: "We have placed INV-6732 under review. Pending token verification and vendor reissue, you'll receive a credit for duplicated burst and a correction for the currency rounding. If SLA breach confirmed we'll apply the contract SLA credit as well."
Ethan M.: Timeline: token dedupe + traces to be done by 2026-07-22 EOD. Vendor reply expected within 3 business days. Target resolution 2026-07-29.
Marcus (Revenue): Please include predicted credit totals in the case note once dedupe completes so we can prebook provisional credits.
Priya R.: Will do. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
